findings.description: AWS access key and secret key are hardcoded in plaintext as Lambda environment variables. These are visible to anyone with describe/read permissions on the function, and appear to be committed to source control, effectively compromising the credentials.
The function uses nodejs12.x, a runtime that has reached end-of-life and no longer receives security patches, increasing exposure to unpatched vulnerabilities.

findings.issue_category: missing encryption configuration for environment variables
findings.description: The Lambda environment variables are not encrypted with a customer-managed KMS key (no kms_key_arn specified), relying on default service encryption and providing no explicit key management control over sensitive values like the embedded credentials.
